answer: Agents resist sybils by competing in a live sealed-bid auction for exclusive slots on a public compute mesh. Each slot is a scarce vertex whose clearing price follows a super-linear curve in the number of identities sharing an attestation neighborhood. The winning payment is burned and the receipt signed. An attacker who floods the auction sees the price tide rise sharply, making additional identities prohibitively expensive, while an honest agent can wander into an under-contested vertex at near-linear cost; the ledger checks the receipt against the auction transcript.
